status: New PDF reconstruction adapter introduced by M2 Phase A.

changes.reason: The approved design gives each conversion direction its own adapter. Source PdfDocument.ToTarget, out-report and async OfficeConversionResult<T> forms replace the old result pairs.

extraChanges.note: Async conversion entry points capture options before deferred work or resource awaits. The same snapshot supplies resource/size limits and final FailOnLoss acceptance; caller-owned template documents and callbacks retain their ownership.
Reconstruction diagnostic producer identifiers follow the new Pdf.Excel package owner; export identifiers remain in Excel.Pdf.
Canonical SaveAs output failures retain the completed conversion report through the shared internal output helper; cancellation continues to propagate unchanged.

InternalsVisibleTo grants the existing browser engine and its tests access to detailed conversion and serialization evidence. This preserves browser diagnostics while keeping conversion kernels outside the public API.

Worksheet sizing calls use ExcelColumnWidth.Characters for existing stored column units and ExcelColumnWidth.Length(OfficeLength.Points(...)) for existing row points. Default dimension reads convert explicitly at numeric format boundaries. This is a mechanical consumer migration; conversion/layout behavior is retained.

extraChanges.old: The migrated typed table insertion auto-fits PDF-imported columns even when ExcelPdfImportOptions.AutoFitColumns is false.
extraChanges.new: Disable insertion-level autofit and let the importer fit once after number formats, only under its own explicit AutoFitColumns policy.
extraChanges.reason: Retain default worksheet widths and source column-proportion budgets when requested. Modern authoring table defaults remain unchanged for ordinary AddTable callers.
extraChanges.note: All18 source-backed column-geometry cases pass on net10.0, including saved XLSX and ODS with disabled/default/enabled fitting and normalized source proportions.

applicationStatus: Phase A applied and validated on the supported macOS targets. Phase B and Tier 2 entries retain their status; Windows .NET Framework validation remains pending.
authority: Docs/officeimo.api-design.md, including the c526a10ad2 framework decision; the approved design overrides M0 open questions.
